capabilities: register Obsidian to start when the current Windows user logs in
start minimized to the taskbar or hidden to the tray on a marked launch
delay startup by a set number of seconds and optionally open a named default vault
add a per-vault tray icon with Show, Hide, and Quit this vault controls
keep the vault running when its main window is closed (close to tray)
extras: Uses Node APIs Obsidian flags as elevated access (fs, child_process reg.exe query); relies on a non-public Electron bridge, so compatibility is runtime-checked and directory acceptance is not guaranteed; disabling/uninstalling does not remove the startup entry, so Start with Windows must be turned off first; positive delays require Windows Script Host/VBScript.
intentEvidence: This is independent implementation informed by MIT-licensed Background Tray, not a fork.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to launch itself at Windows login, start minimized or hidden to tray, or keep a vault running when its window is closed.

relations.evidence: This is independent implementation informed by MIT-licensed Background Tray, not a fork.

summary: Windows-only plugin that starts Obsidian at login and optionally keeps each vault in the system tray with show/hide, quit, and close-to-tray controls.
